			</div><div class="et_pb_section et_pb_section_2 et_section_regular" >
				<div class="et_pb_row et_pb_row_3 et_animated">
				<div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_2 et_pb_column_5  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough">
				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_4  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p style="text-align: left;">Join this trip<br /><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Gagalin, Helvetica, Arial, Lucida, sans-serif; font-size: 26px;">Let&#8217;s discover</span></p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_5  et_pb_text_align_justified et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p class="p1"><b>Join us for 8 days and nights on the beautiful Greek island of Rhodes!</b><b></b></p>
<p class="p2">Perfect weather, cool excursions, tasty meals, and plenty of good vibes: this is the summer escape you’ve been waiting for.</p>
<p>Get ready for a week of sun, sea, culture, and adventure in one of Greece’s most vibrant islands. From 28 August, we’re staying right behind the beach in Fanes, at Club Meltemi and our hotel next door: with breakfast and dinner included, gear storage, and full access to the station&#8217;s facilities. <br /><strong>This is <i>the</i> time of year to be here.</strong></p>
<p><strong> </strong></p>
<p><strong></strong><span style="font-size: 16px;">This trip is for all levels, with the focus on intermediate/independent kiters. We can arrange lessons for beginners. </span></p>
<p>Some of the activities; Trick clinics, a roadtrip to the south, daily sessions in front of your bed, Greek food, sunsets, yoga &amp; Kite, Kite, Kite.</p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px;">Our aim is to create a like minded group, full of adventure-chasers aged 28 to 50 (at heart). This is to create awesome friendships to last way longer than this camp.. A total of 13 spots are available..</span></p>
<p>You can choose your room, add-ons &amp; extras as desired.</p></div>

			</div><div class="et_pb_row et_pb_row_19 et_animated et_pb_gutters2">
				<div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_2 et_pb_column_34  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough">
				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_tabs et_pb_tabs_0 et_animated " >
				<ul class="et_pb_tabs_controls clearfix">
					<li class="et_pb_tab_0 et_pb_tab_active"><a href="#">Program</a></li><li class="et_pb_tab_1"><a href="#">Where</a></li><li class="et_pb_tab_2"><a href="#">Wind</a></li><li class="et_pb_tab_3"><a href="#">Spots</a></li><li class="et_pb_tab_4"><a href="#">Weather</a></li>
				</ul>
				<div class="et_pb_all_tabs">
					<div class="et_pb_tab et_pb_tab_0 clearfix et_pb_active_content">
				<div class="et_pb_tab_content"><p style="text-align: left;"><em>This is an exemple of what the week&#8217;s program could be.. but it changes with the wind.</em></p>
<p><em> </em></p>
<p><strong> </strong><strong>Saturday </strong><br />TRAVEL/Arrival day &#8211; Check in is from 4pm, we are looking forward to meeting you! Our driver will be there to pick you up from the airport. Within 30 minutes you will be at our spot. <br />Get your fins ready &amp; get your first kite session in!</p>
<p><strong>Sunday</strong><br />The very first full day.<br />9 AM breakfast<br />11 AM Group &amp; Spot introduction<br />12 AM First sessions!<br />2 PM &#8211; lunch break<br />4 PM &#8211; kite till sunset<br />8 PM &#8211; dinner time!</p>
<p><strong>Monday</strong><br />9 AM Brekkie<br />11 AM Theory clinic<br />12 AM &#8211; Kite kite kite (eatsomething) kite kite<br />7 PM &#8211; Let&#8217;s meet up for a sunset drink at the beach bar.<br />8 PM Dinnertime</p>
<p><strong>Tuesday </strong><br />8 AM &#8211; Yoga &#8211; You can feel your body could use a good stretch after a few days of kiting for hours and hours.. Let&#8217;s go!<br />9 AM Breakfast &amp; Chill<br />12 AM Clinic 2<br />2 PM Lunch break<br />4 PM Kite kite kite<br />7 PM Sunset beers at the beach bar<br />8 PM Dinner at our fav resto in town</p>
<p><strong>Wednesday </strong><br />8 AM Brekkie<br />9 AM Day trip to Rhodes town &#8211; let&#8217;s discover<br />2 PM  maybe lunch, no?<br />4 PM  Back at the hotel for a sunset session<br />8 PM Dinner</p>
<p><strong>Thursday<br /></strong>8 AM Breakfast<br />9 AM Daytrip to Prasonisi<br />2 PM Lunch break on the spot<br />4 PM More sessions<br />7 PM Sunset drinks &amp; dinner<br />10 PM back at the hotel </p>
<p><strong>Friday</strong><br />8 AM Yoga<br />9 AM Breakfast<br />10 AM Chilllll<br />1 PM Downwinder from Theologos<br />8 PM Dinnertime </p>
<p><strong>Saturday<br /></strong>The last day. Whatever YOU want to do + pack up the gear at the end of the day (the worst moment) + sad goodbye party. There is space to clean and pack your gear.<br />8 PM Dinner in time </p>
<p><strong>Sunday</strong></p>
<p>&#8211; SAD GOODBYE &#8211; but happy memories. What a week it was <span>🥰</span></p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_tab et_pb_tab_1 clearfix">
				<div class="et_pb_tab_content"><p class="p1"><b>Rhodes: Built by the Sea</b><b></b></p>
<p class="p3">Surrounded by the Aegean and Mediterranean Seas, <b>Rhodes </b>is all about wind, water, and Greek beauty. The island’s unique position creates reliable summer conditions, with steady sea breezes that kick in at afternoons — perfect for long sessions on the water.</p>
<p class="p3">The coastline is varied and dynamic: pretty beaches, clear water, old towns &amp; pine forests. Some spots stay empty and relaxed, while others are more packed and with stronger wind. It’s a place where mornings ease in and afternoons shift into full-on action.</p>
<p>Ready to discover this part of Greece?</p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_tab et_pb_tab_2 clearfix">
				<div class="et_pb_tab_content"><p style="text-align: left;">The Meltemi kicks in daily on the Greek islands in this area. We expect 15 to 25 knots daily &#8211; we hope to have the best of luck &amp; have daily sessions.</p>
<p><strong>Adviced sizes:</strong><br />45-60 kg&#8217;s &#8211; 7 / 9 / 11 set<br />60-80 kg&#8217;s &#8211; 8 / 10 / 12 set<br />80-100 kg&#8217;s &#8211; 8 / 10 / 13 set</p>
<p style="text-align: left;"></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_tab et_pb_tab_3 clearfix">
				<div class="et_pb_tab_content"><p style="text-align: left;">Our main spot is in front of the hotel. The spot is one of the few beaches in the area where you have sand under your feet. There is a small beach break, warm water and cruisy wind. <br />We&#8217;ll head to Prasonisi for a day, expect waves and crowds there &amp; a lot stronger wind.</p>
<p>The main spot has a compressor to inflate your kite, beach assistants &amp; a rescue service.</p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_tab et_pb_tab_4 clearfix">
				<div class="et_pb_tab_content"><p style="text-align: left;"><strong>Perfect Summer</strong><br />It will be nice &amp; sunny, but if we have lots of wind, the evenings get chilly. Shorts &amp; a t-shirt are more than enough during the day. On windy evenings you probably want jeans &amp; a jacket.</p>
<p>If we have no wind, it might get hot hot. Let&#8217;s see what we get 😉</p>
<p>Sunglasses, good sunscreen &amp; lycra are adviced.<br />Bring a shorty if you are cold blooded!</p>
<p><strong>Wetsuit advice:</strong><br />&#8211; 1 mm shorty for &#8216;normal people&#8217;<br />&#8211; 2 mm shorty for those that get cold easily<br />&#8211; Lycra for if you don&#8217;t get cold anyway.</p></div>
			</div>
				</div>
			</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_2 et_pb_column_35  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough et-last-child">
				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_image et_pb_image_7">

				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_29 et_clickable  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p>Book</p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_divider_2 et_clickable et_pb_space et_pb_divider_hidden"><div class="et_pb_divider_internal"></div></div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_30 et_clickable  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p>your</p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_divider_3 et_pb_space et_pb_divider_hidden"><div class="et_pb_divider_internal"></div></div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_31 et_clickable  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p>Camp</p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_divider_4 et_pb_space et_pb_divider_hidden"><div class="et_pb_divider_internal"></div></div>
			</div>
			</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_section et_pb_section_13 et_section_regular" >
				<div class="et_pb_row et_pb_row_21">
				<div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_4_4 et_pb_column_37  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough et-last-child">
				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_32  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p style="text-align: left;">Quality &amp; Care<br />
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: Gagalin, Helvetica, Arial, Lucida, sans-serif; font-size: 26px;">Why us?!</span></p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_33  et_pb_text_align_justified et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p><strong>We&#8217;ll take great care of you!<br /></strong><strong></strong><span style="font-size: 16px;"><br />We arrange everything for you and make sure you know when to be where. </span></p>
<p>Our aim is to bring the right people to the right place. To be at the right spot for the wind and maximize your time on the water.   </p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px;">We value respect &amp; kindness and ask you to treat your kite buddies and staff with that same manner. We are not a party-camp, but will host some party nights and can get you to the party if you want a bit more.</span></p>
<p>Ps. If you let us do our thing, you will get to do your thing in the best way possible 🙂<br />Pss: We host kitesurfers from all over the world. Come with an open heart and you will make kite friends for life! <em></em></p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_button_module_wrapper et_pb_button_7_wrapper et_pb_button_alignment_center et_pb_module ">
				<a class="et_pb_button et_pb_button_7 et_animated et_pb_bg_layout_dark" href="https://bookings.toowettoshred.com/en/product/kite-camp-greece/" data-icon="">I&#039;m joining!</a>
			</div>
			</div>
			</div>
			</div><div id="faq" class="et_pb_section et_pb_section_14 et_pb_with_background et_section_regular" >
				<div class="et_pb_row et_pb_row_22">
				<div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_4_4 et_pb_column_38  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough et-last-child">
				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_34  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner">FAQ<br />
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: Gagalin, Helvetica, Arial, Lucida, sans-serif; font-size: 26px;">For the kitesurf camp&nbsp;</span></div>
			</div>
			</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_with_border et_pb_row et_pb_row_23">
				<div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_3 et_pb_column_39  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough">
				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_toggle et_pb_toggle_0 et_pb_toggle_item  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_toggle_close">
				<h5 class="et_pb_toggle_title">Can I come all by myself?</h5>
				<div class="et_pb_toggle_content clearfix"><strong>Yes</strong> Please do! Most of our guest are &#8216;solo&#8217; travellers at the beginning of the week. You will make friends here before you know it 🙂</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_toggle et_pb_toggle_1 et_pb_toggle_item  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_toggle_close">
				<h5 class="et_pb_toggle_title">What wetsuit do I need?</h5>
				<div class="et_pb_toggle_content clearfix"><p>A shorty should be enough 🙂 <br />Bring a lycra too!<br />Easy, right? </p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_toggle et_pb_toggle_2 et_pb_toggle_item  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_toggle_close">
				<h5 class="et_pb_toggle_title">I have a special diet. Can I join?</h5>
				<div class="et_pb_toggle_content clearfix"><p>The meals are served at a buffet, but are not as varied as we like. If you have severe allergies or eat vegan/vegetarian, please contact us before booking. We will check what is possible.</p>
<p>Note: your host eats veggie, so there will always be something to eat. </p></div>
			</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_3 et_pb_column_40  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough">
				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_toggle et_pb_toggle_3 et_pb_toggle_item  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_toggle_close">
				<h5 class="et_pb_toggle_title">Can I book private lessons?</h5>
				<div class="et_pb_toggle_content clearfix"><p>Yes, for as many hours as you want. The Kite Centre has a lot of instructors but we prefer to pre-book to be sure.</p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_toggle et_pb_toggle_4 et_pb_toggle_item  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_toggle_close">
				<h5 class="et_pb_toggle_title">What does a typical day look like?</h5>
				<div class="et_pb_toggle_content clearfix"><p>Hmmmm, it could be:</p>
<p>8 AM Breakfast<br />10 AM Yoga<br />11 AM Quick session before lunch<br />1 PM lunch time!<br />3 PM After lunch party on the water, are you ready?</p>
<p>6 PM Sunset drinks<br />7 PM dinner time<br />10 PM sleep / party / party in bed<br /><em><br />(Some nights everyone is so tired and just wants to sleep at 10. It&#8217;s funny what kiting does to you..)</em></p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_toggle et_pb_toggle_5 et_pb_toggle_item  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_toggle_close">
				<h5 class="et_pb_toggle_title">My flight arrives late</h5>
				<div class="et_pb_toggle_content clearfix"><p>No worries! Our driver will be there. <br />But, there should be a better option available? Check out all flights at Momondo.com or Cheaptickets.com</p></div>
			</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_3 et_pb_column_41  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough et-last-child">
				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_toggle et_pb_toggle_6 et_pb_toggle_item  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_toggle_close">
				<h5 class="et_pb_toggle_title">Do I bring my own gear?</h5>
				<div class="et_pb_toggle_content clearfix"><p>Your own is usually the most comfy, so we recommend bringing your own set.</p>
<p>If for whatever reason you cannot bring your gear or want to travel light; please let us know well in advance and book the Advanced+rental pack.</p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_toggle et_pb_toggle_7 et_pb_toggle_item  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_toggle_close">
				<h5 class="et_pb_toggle_title">Do I bring sunscreen?</h5>
				<div class="et_pb_toggle_content clearfix"><p><b>Absolutely!</b></p>
<p><b> </b></p>
<p><b></b>Loads. Bring good sunscreen to keep you protected. Zinc might be usefull too. The more the better 😉</p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_toggle et_pb_toggle_8 et_pb_toggle_item  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_toggle_close">
				<h5 class="et_pb_toggle_title">Can I prepare myself for the sessions?</h5>
				<div class="et_pb_toggle_content clearfix"><p><b>Yess!</b></p>
<p><b></b>We love the way you think.<br />We advice adding some extra workouts to your routine to get through 8 days of kiting. Focus on the abs &amp; the legs. Good luck!</p>
<p>Duotone has a great library of video&#8217;s (for all levels), so if you want to mentally prepare for some new tricks, have a look <a href="https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLwYlLMr01z4EmqeIMMBo0JaP8K-0qG-9R" target="_blank" rel="noopener">HERE</a> </p></div>
			</div>
			</div>
